# DEGREE 12, DIAMETER 4: 6,156 VERTICES
# -------------------------------------
# 6,156 vertices, 36,936 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 12, every pair of vertices within 4
# steps of each other.
#
# Route-chart lift: the controller is the Z_19-lift of a 4-vertex Schreier base (76 vertices, symbols
# a, b and their inverses), the fibre F_3^4; (v, x) is joined to (t(v), M_t x + lambda d_t) for every
# symbol t and lambda in F_3 (charts in construction.json).
#
# Vertex 81 v + x0 + 3 x1 + 9 x2 + 27 x3 is the pair (v, x), v = 19 c + g the controller vertex (c,
# g).
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..6155; README.md describes the construction.

# symbol a: (v, x) -- (a(v), M x + lambda d) (the same edges as a^-1)
